# U.S. Department of Justice

> > Official website of the U.S. Department of Justice, providing access to legal resources, immigration review systems, and government services.

The Department of Justice (DOJ) is the federal executive department responsible for enforcing the law and defending the interests of the United States. This portal includes access to the Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR) and its Electronic Case Access System (ECAS) for immigration proceedings and attorney resources.

## Key Topics

- Department of Justice (DOJ)
- Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR)
- Electronic Case Access System (ECAS)
- Immigration Review
- U.S. Government Legal Services
- Authorized Access Systems
- Attorney Resources
- Falls Church, VA Operations
- Government System Monitoring
- Legal Notices and Disclaimers

## Immigration Review Resources

- [Help](https://portal.eoir.justice.gov/Help): ECAS help and contact information for EOIR immigration resources

## Optional

- [Disclaimer](https://portal.eoir.justice.gov/): Legal disclaimer for EOIR government system authorized access
